briefings.title: JPM's Agather & Herbst on Texas Wealth Wave

people.name: Elaine Agather
people.role: Global Vice Chair, J.P. Morgan Private Bank and Chairman, JPMorgan Chase Dallas Region

people.name: Ashley Herbst
people.role: Managing Director & Head of Dallas, J.P. Morgan Private Bank

briefings.tldr: J.P. Morgan Private Bank leaders Elaine Agather and Ashley Herbst discuss how Texas is experiencing a massive wealth wave driven by economic diversity, corporate relocations, and generational wealth transfer, while adapting client relationships to new technology and alternative asset classes like sports.
